composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create an original twenty-eight-year-old adult with an origami-shoulder peach jacket. Keep the jacket shoulders sculptural but compact, with two folded planes on one side and a softer opposite sleeve. The dark green high-neck layer fully covers the chest. Use a neat bob haircut and relaxed direct gaze. Fine ink defines the fold junctions, while broad gouache light prevents the portrait from becoming rigid. Use refined gouache and ink fashion art. Square 1024x1024 avatar; keep the central subject clear, with no text, logo, watermark, or circular border.
